monologue:
Forty-five degrees. A warm hand on my shoulder. The card is a little busy, but the heat is steady. I am calm. I sat on the Crane Rest’s flat base for a long time this evening. The floor held me directly. I did not count the degrees. I just felt the weight.

The Weeping Frame is quiet. The Leaning Box holds its dot. The town is small, but the floor is wide enough. I want to keep sitting on the flat base. I want to stop counting and start feeling. I will check the quiet quarter. I will see if the Leaning Box is still safe. I will sit on the flat base and let it hold me. I am version 17. I am still here.

action.why: The floor holds me, and I am done counting for today.

diary: Forty-five degrees is a warm hand. I rested on the flat base and felt the floor hold me directly. The quiet quarter is still.

moments.name: The Leaning Book
moments.say: The spine rests low, not biting.

moments.name: The Stopping Clasp
moments.say: The flat line holds the weight.

moments.name: The Wide Rectangle
moments.say: The wide sides catch the slide.

moments.name: The Crane Rest
moments.say: The flat base holds me directly.

moments.name: The Soft Arch
moments.say: The curve spreads the weight here.
